content.short: Swim Protocol is a cross-chain bridge on Solana.
content.description: Swim Protocol acts as a cross-chain bridge that links Solana's DeFi ecosystem with other blockchains. It enables native asset transfers across chains without the need to wrap assets first, preserving Solana-based assets in their original form as they move between networks. By design, this approach facilitates DeFi interoperability, allowing Solana-originated tokens to participate in non-Solana DeFi ecosystems without additional wrapping steps.
content.meta: Swim Protocol enables cross-chain asset transfers and DeFi interoperability. Discover Swim Protocol and other DeFi Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
